appTagline: End-to-end encrypted messenger with no phone number and no backup
auth.explainer.body1: Your account lives in this browser. Messages are end-to-end encrypted: the server stores only encrypted messages and cannot read them.
auth.explainer.body2: There is no backup, no recovery and no password reset. If you lose this device or clear the browser, your messages and your handle are gone. To move to another device, start the transfer from this one.
auth.restore.label: Saved account
auth.restore.rejected: Could not connect to this account. This device may have been removed from it. Your keys are still in this browser.
auth.restore.bootFailed: Could not sign in to the saved account: {error}
auth.restore.loadFailed: Could not load the saved account: {error}
auth.form.handle.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. It can't be changed later.
auth.form.handle.invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, up to 32 characters
auth.wipe: Delete all Veil data from this browser
auth.wipe.bodyHandle: This deletes @{handle}'s keys and all Veil data in this browser. You will not be able to sign in to @{handle} again.
auth.wipe.body: This deletes all Veil keys and data in this browser.
newChat.title: New chat
newChat.sub: Enter their handle. They need an account on the same server.
conv.empty: No chats yet. Start one with New chat.
chat.empty.title: Choose a chat
chat.mutePrompt: Mute for how many minutes? (60 = 1 hour, 1440 = 24 hours, 999999 = for good)
msg.empty.title: No messages yet
reaction.mineTitle: Your reaction. Click to remove it
send.queued: You're offline. The message will be sent when you're back online.
send.tooLong: The message is too long (at most {max} characters)
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications
notifications.blockedInBrowser: Allow notifications in your browser settings
session.incompatible: The account saved in this browser uses an older format that can't be used any more. Create a new account.
session.wipePartial: Some data could not be deleted: {error}
keyChange.banner: @{handle}'s safety number changed. Messages from the new key stay locked until you review it.
keyChange.confirmBody: They may have switched devices, or someone may be trying to intercept this conversation. Only accept after confirming with them another way (in person, a call).
keyChange.sendBlocked: This contact's safety number changed. Review it at the top of the chat before sending.
storage.upgradeBlocked: Close Veil in your other tabs to continue: an older version is still open there.
storage.wipeBlocked: Close Veil in your other tabs to finish deleting: an older version there is keeping the data open.
peer.notUpgraded: This contact's app is too old for end-to-end encrypted sessions. Ask them to update.
peer.unavailable: Could not start an encrypted session with this contact.
keyChange.bannerVerified: @{handle}'s safety number changed. You had verified them, so compare the new number before you trust it.
keyChange.bannerUnverifiedDevice: @{handle} is using a device you have not verified. You had verified them: compare this device's safety number before you trust it.
keyChange.superseded: @{handle}'s key changed again while you were reviewing it. Review the new one.
keyChange.declineBody: Messages from it stay locked and you will not be asked about it again. This chat goes on sending to the key you already have for @{handle}. If they really use this device, its messages will stay unreadable here.
keyChange.declineSessionKey: This chat sends to that key, so it cannot be declined. Compare safety numbers with @{handle} instead.
keyChange.sendRefused: The key this chat would send to is one you declined, or a device of another contact. Nothing was sent.
safety.unverifiedDevice: This device was accepted before you verified @{handle}, but never verified. Only mark it verified after comparing this number with them.
group.composerFrozen: Group messages can't be sent from the web yet
safety.title: Safety number with @{handle}
safety.pendingKey: This is a new key that has not been accepted yet. Only verify it after comparing it with them.
safety.explain: Compare this number with @{handle} in person or over a call. If it doesn't match, someone may be between you.
safety.copyByHand: This browser didn't let the page copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
safety.pastePlaceholder: Paste the code from their screen
safety.mismatch: The codes do not match. Do not trust this key.
safety.noKey: No key pinned for @{handle} yet: exchange a message first.
safety.notSignedIn: This device has not signed in yet. Sign in once, then compare safety numbers.
legacy.badge: Older format: not forward secret, sender not verified
legacy.composerFrozen: This identity uses the old format and cannot send
legacy.banner: This browser's identity uses the old format. You can read its history but not send. Create a new identity to keep messaging.
history.deleteBody: This device's copy of the conversation is destroyed for good, and messages the server still holds stay unreadable here. The other side keeps theirs.
report.title: Report @{handle}
report.explain: Only the reason you pick and the IDs of this message and conversation are sent. The message's content stays on this device.
accountConflict.banner: This @{handle} is a different account from the @{handle} you talked with before. It may be someone posing as them: nothing is opened or sent here until you choose to talk to this account.
accountConflict.confirmBody: Nothing ties this account to the @{handle} you talked with or verified before: names come from the server, which can show any account under one. Continue only if you confirmed with them another way (in person, a call) that this account is theirs.
accountConflict.composerFrozen: A different account under a name you know: review it above
unissuedHandle.banner: @{handle} is not a name Veil gives out: no account can have a name with an invisible character, a letter from another alphabet, a capital letter or a space in it. It may be someone posing as a contact you know: nothing is opened or sent here until you choose to talk to this account.
unissuedHandle.confirmBody: No Veil account can have this name: the list this device received was altered to show it, perhaps to look like someone you know. Continue only if you confirmed with them another way (in person, a call) that this account is theirs.
unissuedHandle.composerFrozen: A name Veil never gives out: review it above
ownHandle.banner: This conversation is listed under your own name, @{handle}, but with another account. No one else can have your name: the list this device received was altered, perhaps to pass someone off as you. Nothing is opened or sent here until you choose to talk to this account.
ownHandle.confirmBody: No other Veil account can have your name: the server showed this account under it. Continue only if you confirmed another way (in person, a call) whose account this is.
ownHandle.composerFrozen: Another account under your own name: review it above
safety.verifiedBadgeTitle: You compared this chat's safety number
